subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add an official model/session reconcile-reset surface, and should it only report and opt-in clear explicit pins or ever rewrite them automatically?
rationale: The remaining behavior affects persisted session state, explicit user model/auth choices, agent-level overrides, generated model state, and provider routing, so code inspection cannot decide the intended upgrade semantics safely.

options.title: Add dry-run plus opt-in reset
options.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped flags to clear them.

options.title: Status and doctor only
options.body: Keep runtime precedence unchanged and only improve diagnostics, warnings, and doctor/config validation for shadowed or invalid model refs.

options.title: Change reset precedence
options.body: Make resets or default-model changes automatically clear or override existing pins, accepting a compatibility break for users who rely on durable session or agent selections.

recommendation.title: Add dry-run plus opt-in reset
recommendation.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped flags to clear them.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed history across shared model resolution, session display helpers, and current model documentation, making him the best available decision owner from the traced history.
